nom: Knemo RIGHT AWAY Thincognito Spot Patch - 2 Pack

avis.texte: my favorite patches ever. they never disappoint to pull gunk out. my pimples literally become flat after one patch, but with other patches ill have to use two or three. highly recommend

avis.titre: Invisible, hygienic, and super easy to use
avis.texte: I love how unique the application is—I don't even need to touch the patch directly, so it feels much more hygienic. And it's honestly almost invisible! When I wear makeup, I can see it just a tiny bit, but on bare skin it blends in so well that I have to look closely to even find where I put it before removing. It's seriously impressive!

I got it because I saw it everywhere on Tiktok and it did nott disappoint. I've worn it to class, brunch, meetings, and no one noticed. It blends right into my skin and absorbs all the white gunk. And I never have to deal with the edges folding over with my fingernail because of the applicator. Obsessed.
